summary: Focus Universal Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose compliance with Nasdaq continued listing standards. The filing describes a Series B preferred stock conversion and a private placement with warrants, including the full exercise of pre-funded warrants. There are no terms stated for a special situation; it merely updates equity levels to meet Nasdaq's $2.5 million minimum. No board recommendation or advisor is named, and no transactional structure or regulatory clock is indicated beyond routine listing compliance. The filing does not trigger any event-driven category; it is a routine compliance update.
